features.text: Motor torque and back-EMF, the gearbox, wheel grip and rolling resistance.
Battery sag under load and the Uno brown-out.
The reflectance array reading the surface under it, with its height.

hints: The robot resets as soon as the motors start: look at the battery voltage while the motors start. A weak pack sags and the Uno browns out.
The robot steers away from the line: one motor runs the wrong way. Check the left motor leads.
The robot never finds the line: read the sensor channels. If every one sits at the same value the array is too high or stuck.
The left wheel spins and the robot drifts: the wheel is slipping, so look at the grip under it.
Still stuck? Compare each reading with the run before you changed anything.
guide.lede: A two-wheel robot that follows a black line round an oval track.
guide.overview: Eight reflectance sensors under the nose see the line. The Uno turns where the line sits under the array into a steering difference between the two motors, and the robot follows the track for a lap.

specs.label: What it models
specs.value: Motor torque and back-EMF, the gearbox, wheel grip and rolling resistance, battery sag, the array's reading and its height. It does not model the IMU, wheel flex or the floor's roughness.

steps: Fix the two TT gear motors to the chassis and press a 65 mm wheel onto each shaft. Put the caster ball at the back.
Mount the QTR-8RC array at the nose, about 3 mm above the floor, with OUT1 on the left.
Wire the battery to VIN on the Uno and to VM on the TB6612FNG, and join the grounds.
Wire the driver: PWMA to D5, AIN1 to D7, AIN2 to D8, PWMB to D6, BIN1 to D10, BIN2 to D4. Put STBY on 5 V.
Wire the array: OUT1 to OUT8 to A0 to A5, D11 and D12, LEDON to D2, VCC to 5 V.
Press Run. The robot follows the oval and the serial monitor prints a line each time it completes a lap.
Open the Robot checks and the top-down view, then enable a fault and run again.
guide.title: Line follower

meta.description: An Arduino Uno, a TB6612FNG driver, two TT gear motors with 65 mm wheels, a caster and an eight-sensor reflectance array on a two-wheel chassis. It drives round a 19 mm oval track in the physics arena. Part values are iynk assumptions unless a part says otherwise.
meta.title: Line follower

faults.note: Weak pack: the Uno resets when both motors start.
Swaps the left motor leads: the robot steers away from the line.
Lifts the sensor array to 30 mm: the reflectance contrast fades.
Every channel is stuck at full scale: the array sees no edge.
The left wheel grips a quarter as well: it spins and the robot drifts.

tests.name: Follows the line for a lap
